about: 3D inventory (tools/3d_inventory.py, read from species/3d/models.json and the tables in species/3d/viewer.js). group: the body plan group the shared modelling (and the '3d' preview's realism pass) uses. status: 'individually checked' = a hand-made profile, or the species' head/look set by hand against photos; 'photo-checked on contact sheets only' = its generated colours/pattern were read from and compared with its photo in bulk, its shape was never looked at on its own; 'not checked' = no photo. sharedImprovements: takes the shared group modelling (everything but fossils the viewer does not show). needsCustomWork: honest gaps.

groups.viper: true viper: broad triangular head on a thin neck, heavy body, short abrupt tail
groups.pitviper: pit viper: triangular head with loreal heat pits, heavy body, short tail
groups.rattlesnake: rattlesnake: triangular head, loreal pits, heavy body, short tail ending in a rattle
groups.python: python: long head, labial heat pits, heavy body, thick muscular tail
groups.boa: boa: long head, heavy body, thick prehensile tail
groups.sandboa: sand / rubber boa: blunt head barely wider than the neck, short blunt tail
groups.cobra: cobra: narrow head about as wide as the neck, hood ribs
groups.mamba: mamba: long coffin-shaped head, slender body, long whip tail
groups.deathadder: death adder: broad viper-like head, stout body, thin lure tip
groups.elapid: other elapid: narrow head little wider than the neck, smooth scales
groups.colubrine: typical colubrid: oval head a little wider than the neck
groups.natricine: water / garter snake: long narrow head, keeled scales
groups.racer: racer / whipsnake / green snake: slender, big eyes, long whip tail
groups.vine: vine snake: very slender, long pointed snout, long whip tail
groups.broad: broad-headed colubrid (cat-eyed, tree, snail-eating snakes): broad head on a thin neck
groups.hognose: hognose: stout body, upturned shovel snout
groups.burrow: burrowing snake: blunt head no wider than the neck, small eyes, short tail
groups.blind: blind / thread snake: blunt rounded head, tiny eye spots under the scales, uniform body, spine-tipped tail
groups.sea: sea snake: small head, laterally flattened body, paddle tail
